integrity: The primary full text was inspected at Definition 3.1 and the surrounding semantic development. The two quantified interaction conditions are independently reduced to monotonicity of row and column maxima, then a forced/allowed-cell reconstruction gives the exact counting formula. Direct exhaustive relation-level replay through four worlds agrees with the formula, which was evaluated through six worlds. Earlier topological birelational literature was checked for broader coverage.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only accessibility relations on a fixed finite chain satisfying Definition 3.1 of the source. It does not classify predicate domains, comprehensive models, valuations, or validity, and it does not establish a finite-model property or asymptotic formula.
title: Maxima normal form and exact census for chain birelational relations
